newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Acer buys 15 pct of Hitachi unit.
newsitem.headline: Acer buys 15 pct of Hitachi unit.

text.p: Taiwan computer giant Acer Inc has bought 15 percent of Hitachi Television (Taiwan), a unit of Japan's Hitachi Ltd , for 206.6 million yen, the firms said on Thursday.
The purchase is part of an Acer-Hitachi agreement to jointly develop and market information consumer products, Acer and Hitachi said in a statement.
"The new agreement is Hitachi's latest move in globalising its consumer products operations and the first of such in the area of information consumer products," the statement said.
Acer and Hitachi will cooperate in areas such as Internet terminals and personal computer-ready television sets, it said.
Acer, the world's seventh-biggest computer maker, already makes personal computers for Hitachi that are marketed under the Hitachi brand name.
